patch_list: Custom font

Custom monospace font
Replaces the bundled Roboto Mono font with your own monospace font.
Force system font
Uses the device's system font for UI text. Monospace text keeps its bundled font.

patch_list: No screen lock passkey
Skips the master password / PIN prompt for Bitwarden passkey sign-in and creation on a device with no secure lock screen. Devices with a PIN, pattern, password, or biometric lock are unchanged.

sources.author: D-moniak Patches (Dev)
patch_list: Allow Screenshots & Screen Capture - Bitwarden (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Disables FLAG_SECURE window restrictions to permit taking screenshots and screen recordings in Bitwarden.
AMOLED Pure Black Theme - Bitwarden (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Forces deep AMOLED pure black backgrounds across Bitwarden's vault interface, reducing OLED power draw and eye strain.
Bypass Local IP & HTTP Autofill Restrictions - Bitwarden (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Disables insecure HTTP warnings and local IP address autofill blocks, allowing seamless password autofilling on routers, NAS devices, and local development environments.
Unlock Premium & Integrated TOTP 2FA - Bitwarden (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks Bitwarden Premium features: enables integrated 2FA TOTP code generation and displays vault security report indicators in Bitwarden.
